Definition: a Mekerathite, or inhabitant of Mekerah
BiblicalUsage: Mekerathiy names a man by his home, a Mecherathite, an inhabitant of Mecherah. 1 Chronicles 11:36 lists Hepher the Mecherathite among David's mighty men.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God keeps the names of men the world would forget, even down to the village they came from.
RelatedEvents: David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
